title: staged-lane-handoff-with-sampled-rehearsals-and-auto-retreat
author: Asha Patel
body:
Summary: Introduces a staged-lane handoff controller that coordinates cohort-bound canaries with sampled rehearsal lanes and an automated 'retreat' (rollback) inspector. Motivation: Teams running multi-stage model promotes often need a middle ground between full shadowing and canary traffic fractions. This PR adds a lightweight rehearsal lane that mirrors a sampled subset of traffic through a 'rehearsal' path to validate operational assumptions (latency distribution, KV-cache behavior, and session affinity) before increasing traffic to an active canary. The controller also ships an automated retreat inspector that watches composite safety gates (latency P95, error rate, and regression deltas against baseline metrics) and triggers an ordered retreat with snapshot checkpoints when thresholds are violated.

Changes included: - New controller: rollout/staged_lane_controller.go implementing phased handoff state machine, rehearsal sampling, snapshot checkpointing, and retreat orchestration. - Lightweight policies: rollout/policies/rehearsal_policy.yaml with tunable sampling rates and gate windows. - Operator docs: docs/ops/staged-lane-handbook.md with runbook and recommended thresholds. - E2E test harness: tests/e2e/staged_lane_rehearsal_test.go including synthetic traffic generators and smoke replay for session-coherent requests. - Observability: observability/dashboards/rehearsal_overview.json and new telemetry labels (lane.id, rehearsal.sample_rate). - Integration hooks: api/routing/handshake.go exposes the cohort handshake API used to pin sessions during phased promotes. - Telemetry: metrics/rollout_metrics.go adds retrospective counters for retreat reasons.

Implementation notes: - The rehearsal path shares the same model artifacts but runs in a segregated runtime lane to avoid impacting canary instances. We implemented a soft-prefix cache isolation to prevent KV cache pollution across lanes. - Sampling is deterministic per-cohort via a hashed request key to avoid churn. - Retreat inspector aggregates metrics in a sliding window (configurable) and performs a causal check to reduce false positives (examining aligned request subsets before triggering a retreat).

Testing: - Unit tests: rollout controller state transitions, policy parsing, and handshake unit tests added. - Integration: e2e test runs in CI exercise a simulated latency spike and verify that retreat sequence reverts traffic and captures snapshots. - Manual staging: deployed to the perf-canary cluster for validation with two internal services, observed fallback and replay path behavior under induced tail-latency.

Related work: builds on ENG-4217 (cohort-aware promotes) and complements ENG-4273 (session-coherent replay). See linked Linear tasks.

Checklist: - [x] Controller implementation - [x] Policy schema and defaults - [x] Unit and e2e tests - [x] Docs and runbook - [x] Telemetry and dashboard - [x] Manual validation on canary cluster

Rollout plan: Merge to main, feature flag gated by rollout.feature.staged_lane. Gradual enablement via a canary tenant for two weeks, then wider cohort opening if no regressions observed.

Potential risks and mitigations: - Risk: rehearsal sampling could underrepresent rare error modes. Mitigation: recommended minimal sample floor (0.5%) and a synthetic smoke generator invoked during promotions. - Risk: retreat could be noisy under ephemeral spikes. Mitigation: retreat inspector requires two consecutive offending windows and an optional human-confirmation flag for high-impact tenants.

Merge notes: Squash-merged after approval and CI stabilization. See merge commit for consolidated change log.
commits: Initial implementation of staged lane state machine and rehearsal sampler
Add policy schema and default configs for rehearsal lanes
Expose cohort handshake API and session pinning
Add unit tests for controller transitions and policy parsing
Add e2e test harness, synthetic traffic generator, and smoke replayer
Add telemetry labels and Grafana dashboard JSON
Docs: ops handbook and runbook with thresholds and playbook
review_comments: Dana Li: Nice design. Two asks: 1) make sampling deterministic across deployments (hash salt), 2) add a kill-switch flag for immediate evacuation. Please add tests for salt rotation.

Asha Patel (author): Response: Added hash salt in staged_lane_controller.go and unit tests for salt rotation. Implemented emergency.evict_flag for immediate evacuation. See commit 'add-salt-and-evac-flag'.
Samir Khanna: CI integration tests flaked on synthetic traffic replay, saw occasional session breakage. Can you add a test that asserts session affinity is preserved end-to-end?
Asha Patel: Added session-coherent replay test and adjusted handshake.go to pin session cookies before rehearsal path. Reran CI - integration now stable.
Evan Groves: Observability looks good. One minor suggestion: include the retreat reason code in span tags for easier filtering. Added as a follow-up suggestion; not blocking.
Code owner approvals: Dana Li approved, Samir Khanna approved, Evan Groves approved.
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash with consolidation commit that includes fixes for deterministic sampling and emergency evacuation flag.
release_notes: Add staged-lane handoff controller with sampled rehearsal lanes, automatic retreat inspector, session-cohort handshake API, observability dashboards, and runbook. Feature gated behind rollout.feature.staged_lane.
notes_for_ops: Operators: set rollout.feature.staged_lane to false by default. Recommended initial config: rehearsal.sample_rate: 0.005, snapshot.window_seconds: 300, retreat.thresholds: {p95_ms: 250, error_rate: 0.015}. Use emergency.evict_flag for immediate rollback. See docs/ops/staged-lane-handbook.md for full playbook.
